routes.name: Privremeni boravak po osnovu rada sa radnom dozvolom

note: Bosnia and Herzegovina, read on the Service for Foreigners' Affairs' page on foreigners' stay (sps.gov.ba, under the Law on Foreigners) and in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina's Law on the Employment of Foreigners (Službene novine FBiH 111/2012, as the Federation's employment institute serves it) on 2026-10-30. Temporary residence lasts up to one year unless the permit says otherwise and is granted on a ground the law sets, among them work with a work permit and work without one; it may be extended only on the same ground (renewable). A first application goes through a Bosnian embassy or consulate, or exceptionally to the Service in the country by one holding a long-stay D visa or visa-free stay (either). The work permit is issued on the request of the employer who hires the foreigner, by the cantonal employment service, for no longer than a year; the foreigner may work only at the post or kind of work it was issued for, and a permit issued at one employer's request can't pass to another (work for the sponsor). Permanent residence, of unlimited duration, may be granted after at least five years of approved temporary residence (5 kept); its condition is to have resided continuously in the country on approved temporary residence at least five years before applying, read as asked in the country. Foreigners with approved permanent residence have the right to work in the Federation as citizens do (art. 17; work any); Republika Srpska's and Brčko District's employment laws weren't read, and the form holds one answer for the country. The administrative fees are in an annex not read as text, so none are kept; decision times and naturalisation's years aren't on the page. An earlier draft (wave 8) was held because the permanent resident's right to work was read in without the employment law; art. 17 is now quoted.

sources.title: Službe za poslove sa strancima, Boravak stranaca u BiH
sources.said: je boravak stranca u BiH u trajanju do jedne godine, ako dozvolom boravka nije drugačije određeno. ... Stalni boravak je boravak stranca u BiH u neograničenom trajanju.  Stalni boravak se može odobriti strancu nakon proteka najmanje pet godina odobrenih privremenih boravaka prije podnošenja zahtjeva za stalni boravak. ... Rada sa radnom dozvolom ... Ukoliko postoje dokazi kojim se opravdava produženje privremenog boravka isti je moguće produžiti ali samo po istom osnovu po kojem je prvobitno boravak bio odobren. ... se podnosi putem nadležne Ambasade ili Konzulata BiH. Izuzetno, prvi zahtjev se može podnijeti i u državi kod mjesno nadležne organizacione jedinice Službe pod uslovom da stranac posjeduje vizu za dugoročni boravak – viza D (ukoliko dolazi iz države viznog režima), ili iz statusa bezviznog boravka. ... na osnovu odobrenja privremenog boravka, neprekidno boravi na teritoriji BiH najmanje pet godina prije podnošenja zahtjeva za odobrenje stalnog boravka,

sources.title: Zakon o zapošljavanju stranaca (Sl. novine FBiH 111/2012)
sources.said: na zahtjev poslodavca koji ga zapošljava izdaje kantonalna služba za zapošljavanje prema sjedištu poslodavca ... Na osnovu radne dozvole stranac može raditi samo na onom radnom mjestu ili na onoj vrsti poslova za čije je obavljanje radna dozvola izdata, te na osnovu koje je strancu odobren privremeni boravak. ... Radna dozvola izdata na zahtjev jednog poslodavca ne može se prenositi na drugog poslodavca ... Radna dozvola ne može se izdati sa rokom važenja dužim od jedne godine. ... Stranci sa odobrenim stalnim boravkom u Bosni i Hercegovini, stranci sa odobrenom međunarodnom zaštitom i stranci sa odobrenom privremenom zaštitom imaju pravo na radu Federaciji kao i državljani Bosne i Hercegovine.
